description:
Parse a document into structured blocks, Markdown, HTML or A2UI.
Give the document ONE way:
  content + filename: the document itself. Text formats (Markdown, HTML,
    CSV) as plain text; binary files (DOCX, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, ODT, EPUB, ...)
    base64-encoded with contentEncoding="base64". The filename's extension
    picks the parser, e.g. "report.docx".
  filepath: an https:// URL of a publicly reachable document, or a sample id
    from mcpFormats such as "sample_docx_formatting".
outputFormat: blocks (default), markdown, html, a2ui.
name: mcpParse
title: Parse document
